bottlenecks.title: 3D Lab dev-server runtime/memory remains a full-suite blocker
bottlenecks.evidence: Next dev server restarted near memory threshold during /dashboard/3d-lab; Playwright timed out at 180000 ms and the browser context closed.
bottlenecks.metricBefore: Last complete 3D Lab cold p95 54146 ms
bottlenecks.impact: Blocks reliable full-suite frontend regression testing and indicates heavy route startup/memory pressure.
bottlenecks.verify: Run route-isolated built-app measurement plus heap profiling, then compare 3D Lab route chunks and p95.

bottlenecks.title: Supabase broad-read and missing-limit candidates remain after first tightening pass
bottlenecks.evidence: 9 select-star candidate(s), 160 unbounded read candidate(s), 4 client query block(s).
bottlenecks.impact: Can inflate payloads, RLS work, network bytes, and waterfall latency.
bottlenecks.verify: Continue explicit columns/limits on high-traffic paths, then run targeted EXPLAIN and route perf tests.

bottlenecks.title: Admin content/editor surfaces overfetch and render large lists without virtualization
bottlenecks.evidence: Static audit found broad admin content loads, a 1481-line QuestionsPanel, and unvirtualized list/grouping risks.
bottlenecks.metricBefore: Privileged admin runtime metric requires safe role fixture.
bottlenecks.impact: Affects internal content operations and editor responsiveness.
bottlenecks.verify: Measure admin routes with privileged fixtures; add pagination/virtualization; remeasure.

bottlenecks.title: AI/API routes need mocked latency/error budget benchmarks after timeout wrappers
bottlenecks.evidence: Provider fetch timeout wrappers were added, but mutation/AI/payment POST benchmarks remain blocked without safe mocked/staging fixtures.
bottlenecks.metricBefore: Mutation/AI POST endpoints were not called by safe benchmark harness.
bottlenecks.impact: Can create long tail waits and serverless duration risk.
bottlenecks.verify: Add mocked provider latency benchmarks; track p95/p99 and timeout rate.

bottlenecks.title: Cron routes include N+1/per-user scaling patterns
bottlenecks.evidence: API/backend audit found loops over active users with multiple DB calls per user; focus-review timestamp schema mismatch was fixed but scaling remains unmeasured.
bottlenecks.metricBefore: Cron endpoints require secret and were not automatically called.
bottlenecks.impact: Operational timeout risk grows with active users.
bottlenecks.verify: Measure on local seeded DB by user count and compare batch/RPC refactor.

bottlenecks.title: Bundle-heavy route families need analyzer-backed budgets
bottlenecks.location: analytics, wiki, admin editor, notes, 3D Lab; Mermaid/CodeMirror/Tiptap/Recharts imports
bottlenecks.evidence: Build and hotspot scans show tracked heavy dependencies and large build artifacts; direct 3D imports reduced hub manifest bytes but registry metadata split remains open.
bottlenecks.metricBefore: Build p50 36613 ms; largest static 2290.6 KiB
bottlenecks.impact: Large JS chunks harm cold route load and interaction readiness.
bottlenecks.verify: Add route bundle budgets and rerun perf:build plus perf:frontend.

bottlenecks.title: Dashboard sync dedupe needs production-auth monitoring
bottlenecks.evidence: Local comparison after sync-payload split shows cold p95 delta -8197 ms (-32.58%).
bottlenecks.impact: Dashboard is the primary authenticated landing page; the local fix needs credentialed production-like confirmation.
bottlenecks.verify: Rerun dashboard route/user-flow p95 with safe auth fixture and compare request counts/server logs.
